capabilities: : Handle Chinese input for identifiers and labels
: Insert diagrams via commands or selection
extras: Manual installation required (download main.js, manifest.json, styles.css).
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that makes Mermaid diagrams practical: write plain lines, watch them render, insert in one click.
problem: Writing complex Mermaid diagrams is difficult due to required syntax, and Chinese users frequently encounter parsing errors because Mermaid requires ASCII identifiers.
summary: Merchart is an Obsidian plugin that allows users to write Mermaid diagrams using plain lines and indentation instead of complex syntax, providing live rendering and support for 22 diagram types.
